description:
H1′ — the correction pair, in the Golem shell. Turn 1: 'Zobraz náklady účtu 5010O1 …' — the typo'd code is NOT bound (a G4_METHOD_MISS on a value in FILTER position), so the turn ANSWERS and carries the miss as an honest note rather than guessing an account. Turn 2 is the re-gate: a hypothesis correcting 5010O1 → 501001 comes back through resolve.gate:v1, survives the SAME evidence-class gate as any other candidate, and the gap closes.

⚑ The fixture records what the shipped ladder can and cannot do: under the RV-27 zero-rung default the OS Golem PROPOSES NOTHING, so the correction in turn 2 arrives from outside — a rung an estate enabled, or a user. That is the default working as designed, not a gap in it, and the Kotlin shell (RV-P5, with rungs) must produce the same turn-2 outcome from its own local rung.
invariants: a hypothesis is not evidence — only what survives the gate becomes a binding (RV-7)
a gated binding carries its proposing rung; provenance survives the correction
under the zero-rung default nothing is proposed, and the turn still answers honestly
